# パッケージの読み込み

```{r packages}
library(rio)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
```

# データの読み込み

産業×国×年レベルの参入・退出・現地法人総数データ（Data14 産出）を読み込み、
国×年レベルに集計する。

```{r load-data}
# 高所得EU諸国のリスト（対照群と英国）
EU_HI <- c("AUT", "BEL", "DNK", "FIN", "FRA", "DEU", "IRL", "ITA", "LUX", "NLD", "SWE", "GBR")

# 産業×国×年パネルを読み込み、国×年に集計
entry_exit_country <- rio::import("../../03_data_output/EntryExit/N_affiliate_entry_exit.dta") %>%
  filter(year >= 2010, year <= 2020) %>%
  group_by(iso, year) %>%
  summarise(
    N_entry = sum(N_entry_industry, na.rm = TRUE),
    N_exit  = sum(N_exit_industry,  na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    UK             = as.integer(iso == "GBR"),
    high_income_EU = as.integer(iso %in% EU_HI)
  )
```

# 図作成用の整形

```{r prepare-data}
prepare_high_income_eu_comparison <- function(data, outcome) {
  data %>%
    filter(high_income_EU == 1) %>%
    group_by(year, UK) %>%
    summarise(
      N.mean = mean(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      N.sd = sd(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      N.sd = ifelse(UK == 1 | is.na(N.sd), 0, N.sd),
      Group = ifelse(UK == 1, "GBR", "High-income EU countries")
    )
}

exit_compare <- prepare_high_income_eu_comparison(entry_exit_country, "N_exit")
entry_compare <- prepare_high_income_eu_comparison(entry_exit_country, "N_entry")
```

# 図3a: 英国と高所得EUの退出件数比較

```{r fig3a-plot, dpi=300}
fig3a <- ggplot(data = subset(exit_compare, UK == 0),
                aes(x = year, y = N.mean, color = Group)) +
  geom_line(linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = N.mean - 1.96 * N.sd, ymax = N.mean + 1.96 * N.sd, fill = Group),
    alpha = 0.2,
    linetype = "dotted"
  ) +
  geom_line(data = subset(exit_compare, UK == 1), linetype = "solid", colour = "black") +
  geom_point(data = subset(exit_compare, UK == 1), colour = "black") +
  geom_text(data = subset(exit_compare, UK == 1), aes(label = N.mean), nudge_y = 7, colour = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2016, linetype = "dotted") +
  annotate("text", x = 2016, y = 85, label = "Brexit referendum", colour = "blue") +
  annotate("text", x = 2013, y = 80, label = "UK", colour = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 2013, y = 0, label = "High-income EU countries", colour = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Number of exiting Japanese affiliates",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of exiting affiliates",
    caption = "Solid line: UK. Dotted line: High-income EU countries."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(2010, 2020), breaks = seq(2010, 2020, by = 2))

fig3a

ggsave("../../04_tex/main/Fig3a.eps", fig3a, dpi = 300)
```

# 図3b: 英国と高所得EUの新規参入件数比較

```{r fig3b-plot, dpi=300}
fig3b <- ggplot(data = subset(entry_compare, UK == 0),
                aes(x = year, y = N.mean, color = Group)) +
  geom_line(linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = N.mean - 1.96 * N.sd, ymax = N.mean + 1.96 * N.sd, fill = Group),
    alpha = 0.2,
    linetype = "dotted"
  ) +
  geom_line(data = subset(entry_compare, UK == 1), linetype = "solid", colour = "black") +
  geom_point(data = subset(entry_compare, UK == 1), colour = "black") +
  geom_text(data = subset(entry_compare, UK == 1), aes(label = N.mean), nudge_y = 3.5, colour = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2016, linetype = "dotted") +
  annotate("text", x = 2017, y = 75, label = "Brexit referendum", colour = "blue") +
  annotate("text", x = 2011, y = 70, label = "UK", colour = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 2014, y = 0, label = "High-income EU countries", colour = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Number of new affiliates",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of new affiliates",
    caption = "Solid line: UK. Dotted line: High-income EU countries."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(2010, 2020), breaks = seq(2010, 2020, by = 2))

fig3b

ggsave("../../04_tex/main/Fig3b.eps", fig3b, dpi = 300)
```
